website.note: Company appears to operate under Valion Bio brand; pipeline page renders via JS so WebFetch did not return text content. 10-K used as canonical source.

ctgov.note: Legacy ClearUp sinusitis device studies; no kept active P1/P2/P3 drug trials.

pipeline.modality: Recombinant TLR5 agonist (engineered Salmonella flagellin derivative, ~329 aa, ~35 kDa)
pipeline.target: TLR5 (Toll-like Receptor 5); downstream NF-kB, G-CSF, IL-6 induction
pipeline.license_origin: Licensed February 2025 from Statera Biopharma (worldwide exclusive); license expanded Q2 2025 to neutropenia and to next-gen Entolasta

indications.indication: Acute Radiation Syndrome (ARS) - hematopoietic and GI
indications.trial_name: BLA preparation under FDA Animal Rule (no human efficacy trial required)
indications.trial_design: FDA Animal Rule pathway: pivotal NHP GLP Study Rs-23 (160 rhesus macaques, 7.2 Gy TBI) showed 75% vs 27.5% survival. Human safety data from prior studies in ~150 subjects.
indications.trial_status: Pre-BLA preparation; CGMP manufacturing scale-up at Velocity Bioworks completed Jan 2026 (200x scale-up at 50L)
key_milestones: Q3 2025: Entolimod cell line verified at Scorpius Biomanufacturing site
January 2026: Velocity Bioworks demonstrated 200x manufacturing scale-up at 50L meeting purity/potency
FDA designations: Fast Track; Orphan Drug
